title: Team recordings
scope: Only completed calls that your team answered. Listen on this page only; there is no download.

range.ORDER: The start date cannot be after the end date
range.TOO_LONG: Choose a range of 90 days or less

empty: No team recordings in this date range. Try a wider range.
failed: Could not load recordings. The system may be temporarily unavailable. Try again, and contact your admin if it keeps failing.
unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.
forbidden: You do not have access to team recordings. This page is for supervisors who belong to a team, and recording playback must be enabled. Contact your admin to check your access.

player.notice: Your access is checked every time the next part of the audio is requested.

error.signIn: Your session expired. Sign in again to keep listening.
error.denied: You no longer have access to this recording. Playback stopped.
error.gone: This recording was not found, or you no longer have access to it.
error.notReady: This recording is still being archived. Try again shortly.
error.unsupported: This audio file is in a format the player cannot play.
